band_vocabulary: same as Production evidence bands (STRONG/POSITIVE/NEUTRAL/CAUTION); numeric values come from the existing rule registry, no new numbers

workout_load.hypothesis: a harder final workout signals readiness (to be tested; heavy load is not assumed good in Production)

workout_consistency.rule: trend UP -> STRONG; trend FLAT and workouts_listed >= 3 -> POSITIVE; FLAT -> NEUTRAL; DOWN -> CAUTION; missing -> unobserved

evaluation: pre-race freeze from 2026-11-22; compare each affected index Champion vs Challenger by winner rank, top-3 capture at equal candidate count, and per venue x surface (jra_oos_strata). Stages 30/100/300R; adoption only by Owner decision.
